title: Aurora — edge deploy platform
description: A light, emerald landing page for an edge deploy platform: push once, live in 18 regions in 38 seconds. The hero is a dotted world map where you click any region to push from it and watch the rollout ripple outward while a terminal logs the build. Includes a pipeline bento, canary and rollback controls, a 3D deploy history, a config file and plan picker.
sections: Hero with rollout map and terminal
features: Dotted world map generated from continent outlines, identical on server and client
Click any of 18 regions to push from it; a ring and arcs light regions by distance
Terminal log, timer and live count driven by one motion value
Repo folder peek, build log with dot-matrix loaders and deploy notifications
Canary sliders and a hold-to-roll-back button with undo
Plan radio cards with a springing summary panel
Reduced-motion aware, keyboard accessible, no horizontal scroll at 390px
